messages:
maria: heads-up: a few customers reported the per-model card showing 'negative cost' after cache credits. they get worried it's a billing bug. can we make the data model and labels clearer in the console? :grimacing:
sam: yup, saw 3 tickets this week. immediate fix could be a tooltip on the number: "billing applies cache credits; see breakdown". longer term: show gross vs net side-by-side.
kevin: engineering note: our metrics pipeline currently emits gross_tokens and cache_credits as separate timeseries. we can compute net_tokens in the aggregation layer easily, but need to decide what the UI should call each metric to avoid confusion.
jin: proposal: API surface for console: GET /internal/v1/ui/costs?model=<id>&range=24h returns metrics: ["gross_tokens","cache_credits","net_tokens","amortized_credit","sample_set_id"]. sample_set_id references a hashed list stored in internal S3 for debugging. no raw prompt text leaves the console.
olivia: product prefers gross-for-quotas, net-for-billing. that means the console should show both: quota bar uses gross, billing preview shows net. will confirm with finance.
alex: UX sketch: left column has quota pill (gross) with a small gray sublabel "quota counts gross tokens". center big number is net cost with small info icon that opens a 3-step trace: route -> model variant -> cache impact. right side shows stacked mini-sparklines: gross (light) + net (bold).
sam: we also need sampling for charts. big tenants create noisy spikes that drown the sparkline. backend supports reservoir sampling per-minute; we should surface a "sampling rate" badge and an estimated error margin. e.g., "sampled 1/100, ~98% conf".
jin: implementation caveats: sample_set_id should be rotated daily and contain only request ids hashed with customer-specific salt. retrieval endpoint will require svc token + approver header. also add a redact flag so console never renders raw prompt text.
maria: security + compliance ok?
kevin: yep, hashed ids + access control verified by security. audit log entry on retrieval is mandatory.
olivia: product decision: gross for quotas, net for billing and main card. i'll send final confirmation by 14:30 PT. if that's green, next steps: jin spec endpoints, sam wire UI, alex provide final mocks, kevin add sampling & rotate logic.
ci-bot: build: cost-dashboard/feature-prefetch-clarity #512 passed -> staging (build 3012). https://ci.internal/build/3012 :white_check_mark:
maria: awesome. i'll write the rollout note and add a support FAQ entry explaining the difference. thanks everyone. :pray:
